items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: I was just saying, I was understanding. Oh and one time I played with Desdun. Crash Desdun.

ctx.x: A lot of time. Uh huh. It must have been interesting to travel around throughout the country, Todd.

Yeah. Sightseeing. Yeah. And especially we had our own bus too, you know what I mean. I was just saying, I was understanding. Oh and one time I played with Desdun. Crash Desdun. Oh yeah, Crash Desdun huh? Yeah. I don't even know who it is.
You travel over here? Oh yeah. I'm on New Brunswick. No. That's where he is now, isn't it?
